audit.whatIsWrong: Text called the lane even-to-Kennen through 2+ items, but the packet level chart gives the 2+ item row to Ryze, and the existing whys[6] already says he reclaims the duel.
audit.why: Kennen wins levels 4-6 on poke and the R stun-lock; Ryze's mana scaling flips the side lane once he has two items. 54.42% over 226 games matches an early-favoured, late-losing lane.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 and 6 flipped to Kennen in both layers; 2+ items flipped to Ryze in both layers.

audit.why: Spikes are Kennen level 2-3, level 6 (Slicing Maelstrom, 120s), first item, then Ryze's two-mana-item window. That ordering is right; only the naming of Ryze's tools inside it was wrong.
audit.corrected: Spike text now names Overload (5s flat), Spell Flux (3.5/3.25/3/2.75/2.5) and Rune Prison (11/10.5/10/9.5/9).

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly credits Ryze with a shield ('his early shield', 'his W root and shield', 'shield eats your poke') and calls his root a 'Q-E root combo'.
audit.why: Ryze's current kit has no shield: P Arcane Mastery, Q Overload, W Rune Prison, E Spell Flux, R Realm Warp. Rune Prison (W) only slows unless Spell Flux (E) has applied Flux first, in which case it roots. So the root is E-into-W, not Q-E, and there is no shield to trade through.
audit.corrected: All shield references removed; root sequence stated as Spell Flux (E) into Rune Prison (W) at 615 range, with real cooldowns.
sources: enemyKit W text: 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.'

audit.whatIsWrong: 'trade when his Q is on cooldown' — Overload is the wrong cooldown to wait on.
audit.why: Overload is a flat 5s and is reset by every other Ryze spell, so it is effectively always up. Rune Prison at 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 is the punishable cooldown.
audit.corrected: Trading windows keyed to Rune Prison's ~10s cooldown.
sources: enemyKit Q cd '5' and passive reset text

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentioned that Ryze's Q and E are blockable projectiles.
audit.why: Both carry the projectile flag; Overload is a line skillshot that hits the first enemy struck, so minions eat it.
audit.corrected: Noted that standing behind the wave denies Overload and the Flux setup.
sources: enemyKit flags: projectile on Q and E

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Ryze carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, his Spell Flux into Rune Prison chain out-DPSes you the moment R is down. Close the game before this window.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only after Spell Flux marks you. Bait the E, then engage in the 10s window.

edits.before: A pre-stacked Q-W into auto can chain a third Mark of the Storm stun, and his early shield does not save him from the follow-up.
edits.after: A pre-stacked Q-W into auto chains a third Mark of the Storm stun, and with Overload his only answer he eats the whole follow-up.

edits.before: You hold a poke edge while his Q-E root combo is on cooldown, so you control the wave and chip him below his shield value.
edits.after: You hold the poke edge while Rune Prison (W) sits on its 10-second cooldown, so you control the wave and chip him with free Q.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom plus Q-W-E-Flash three-stacks the stun and locks him through his W root and shield for a guaranteed all-in.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom plus Q-W-E-Flash three-stacks Mark of the Storm and stuns him before Rune Prison's 615 range can root you.

edits.before: With two mana/AP items his root-combo spam and shield out-DPS your squishy body the moment your R is down, so he reclaims the duel.
edits.after: With two mana items his Spell Flux into Rune Prison root out-DPSes your squishy body the moment your R is down, so he takes over.

edits.before: Q-W-E-Flash into Slicing Maelstrom chains three Mark of the Storm stacks and stun-locks him through his W root and shield.
edits.after: Q-W-E-Flash into Slicing Maelstrom chains three Mark of the Storm stacks and stuns him inside Rune Prison's 615 root range.

edits.before: Once Ryze stacks mana/AP his Q-E root-combo spam out-DPSes your squishy body the moment your R is down.
edits.after: Once Ryze stacks mana his Spell Flux into Rune Prison root chain out-DPSes your squishy body when R is down.

edits.before: Ryze has to walk up to melee-range minions to last-hit early, and that is exactly where your Thundering Shuriken (Q) plus Electrical Surge auto on-hit punish him. Throw Q on cooldown and weave an empowered auto to start stacking Mark of the Storm, but do not facecheck a forward Ryze who can land his Q-E and root you in place. At levels 2-3 a clean Q plus W-into-auto can build to a third-stack stun on an overstepping Ryze, and his early shield is not enough to survive the trade that follows.
edits.after: Ryze has to walk up to melee-range minions to last-hit early, and that is exactly where your Thundering Shuriken (Q) plus Electrical Surge auto on-hit punish him. Throw Q on its 7s cooldown and weave an empowered auto to stack Mark of the Storm, but do not facecheck a forward Ryze who can land Spell Flux (E) and then root you with Rune Prison (W). At levels 2-3 a clean Q plus W-into-auto builds to a third-stack stun on an overstepping Ryze, and Overload alone does not save him from what follows.

edits.before: From level 4 you keep the poke edge, but respect that his Q-E root combo can lock you for a full burst rotation, so trade when his Q is on cooldown. Level 6 is your takeover: Q-W to pre-stack two marks, E (Lightning Rush) or Flash onto him, then channel Slicing Maelstrom to slap a third stack and stun-lock him through his W root and shield. He cannot out-trade your full combo here even with his shield up, so force the all-in the moment you hit 6 and have your first AP component.
edits.after: From level 4 you keep the poke edge, but his Spell Flux into Rune Prison roots you for a full burst rotation, so trade only while that 10-second W is down. Level 6 is your takeover: Q-W to pre-stack two marks, E (Lightning Rush) or Flash onto him, then channel Slicing Maelstrom to slap a third stack and stun him before the root lands. He cannot out-trade that combo, so force the all-in the moment you hit 6 and have your first AP component.

edits.before: This is where Ryze flips the lane. Once he has two mana/AP items his Q-E root-combo spam resets fast enough to root-chain and burst your squishy caster body the instant Slicing Maelstrom goes on cooldown, and his shield eats your poke. Your job is to have already won: snowball the lane on your 6 and first-item windows, take plates and roam, and pivot to a teamfight engager. Do not try to 1v1 a six-item Ryze in the side lane late, peel and AoE stun-lock for your team instead.
edits.after: This is where Ryze flips the lane. With two mana items every spell resets Overload's flat 5s cooldown, so Spell Flux into Rune Prison chains roots and bursts your squishy caster body the instant Slicing Maelstrom's 120s starts. Your job is to have already won: snowball the lane on your 6 and first-item windows, take plates and roam, and pivot to a teamfight engager. Do not 1v1 a six-item Ryze in the side lane, peel and AoE stun-lock for your team instead.

edits.before: Land his Q-E root combo to kite you and chunk your low-HP body
edits.after: Land Spell Flux into Rune Prison to root and chunk your low-HP body

edits.before: Reach two mana/AP items where his root-combo spam and shield out-trade your R
edits.after: Reach two mana items where his Spell Flux root chain out-trades your R

notes: Ryze has no shield in the live kit; the page asserted one in five places and called his root a 'Q-E combo'. Root is Spell Flux (E, 615 range) applying Flux, then Rune Prison (W, 615, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9) rooting instead of slowing. Overload is a flat 5s reset by his other spells, so it is never the cooldown to wait on. Level chart rows 4-5, 6 and 2+ items flipped in matched pairs to agree with the packet chart and with the existing whys text.
